CALCULATOR / 01

Estimate wall paint

Measure a rectangular room's length, width and wall height, plus unpainted openings. Enter coverage per litre from your selected product's label.

Planning result—

Enter dimensions and calculate. Values stay in your browser.

Method & sources

Gross wall area = 2 × (length + width) × height. Net area = gross area − openings. Litres = net area × coats ÷ coverage per litre per coat.

This formula covers four walls of a rectangular room at one height. Ceiling, trim, primer, texture and can sizes are not included.
